description: Why the game stutters, from myaku: frame-time percentiles (p50/p95/p99), hitches per minute, and the worst hitches explained. Each has a cause (script, gc, upload, compile, layout, throttled, hidden, unknown), a confidence, the script and function to look at when known, and a hint. Spans show time in debuff's update and render. Prefer this over game_frames to explain stutter; measure in live mode, since headless stepping doesn't reflect real play.
name: game_profile
title: Frame profile
